newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc closes narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc closes narrowly mixed.

text.p: 1430 GMT - The Swiss franc closed narrowly mixed against the mark and dollar in routine trading, dealers said.
Unconfirmed rumours of central bank mark purchases helped bring the German unit off its lows, but it remained weak, traders said. One said the mark could test 82 centimes tomorrow.
The franc drifted through an 80-basis point range against the dollar, which seemed supported around 1.4725 francs.
Dealers said the Swiss National Bank's decision to leave its discount rate steady at 1.0 percent was entirely expected.
* Dollar closes at 1.4785/95 francs, down from yesterday's 1.4835/4845 but barely changed from the opening 1.4800/4810
* Mark ends at 82.60/62 Swiss centimes, up from 82.47/49 at the previous close and the opening 82.46/49
